label: Determining the Period of Sinusoidal Functions
section: Determining the Period of Sinusoidal Functions
subgoals: Read the coefficient B in y = A sin(Bx)
Divide 360 degrees by the absolute value of B
Count the x-distance from one peak to the next

label: Determining Amplitude
subgoals: Read A as the factor in front of the sine or cosine
Drop the sign when A is negative
Halve the vertical distance between trough and peak

label: Identifying the Phase Shift of a Function
section: Identifying the Phase Shift of a Function
subgoals: Write the inside as Bx minus C, not as B times (x minus C)
Set Bx minus C to zero to find where one cycle starts
Shift right by C/B when C is positive
